occurrences.checkable_against: SPD policy proposals on long-term-care financing

evidence.title: Germany news: Reform row raises fears for Merz's coalition

occurrences.checkable_against: German coalition pension-reform proposal
occurrences.quote_span: Among the most contentious plans is the proposed abolition of penalty-free early retirement after 45 years of contributions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: German governing coalition

occurrences.checkable_against: Franziska Hoppermann's interview with Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung
occurrences.quote_span: CDU General Secretary Franziska Hoppermann said Labor Minister Bärbel Bas, who is also an SPD co-leader, needed to produce legislation on pension reform "so that we can finally negotiate concretely."
occurrences.speaker: Franziska Hoppermann
occurrences.subject: German governing coalition

occurrences.checkable_against: Coalition agreement and CDU public statements
occurrences.quote_span: The CDU argues that reforms agreed by the coalition in July were a package and that the SPD cannot expect its preferred measures to go ahead while delaying concessions it made on pensions and the labor market.
occurrences.speaker: Christian Democratic Union
occurrences.subject: German governing coalition

occurrences.checkable_against: CDU parliamentary group statements and coalition tax-reform records
occurrences.quote_span: The Handelsblatt newspaper reported that CDU parliamentary leaders were considering withholding support for Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil's income tax reform until Bas submits legislation on pensions and the labor market.
occurrences.speaker: Handelsblatt
occurrences.subject: German governing coalition

occurrences.checkable_against: Friedrich Merz's statement on labor-market flexibility

occurrences.subject: German governing coalition

occurrences.checkable_against: CDU and SPD coalition statements and scheduled talks
